title: A Past Cause, a Present Result
goal: Say how a different past would change the present with si hubiera and the simple conditional.
grammar: Mixed conditionals: past condition, present result

items: I can say how a different past would change the present with si hubiera and the simple conditional.
I can choose between the simple conditional and habría + participle by looking at the time of the result.
I can use the new words for requirements and obstacles.
